title: Yetsi'as Mitsrayim
author: Moyshe Hurwitz
author_source: MS title page p.1, in German and Russian: "Von Profesor M. Horowitz, Musik von Perlmutter und Wohl" / "Соч. Професора М. Горовица. Музыка Перельмутера и Вола"
notes: MS — 67 pp, 66 GT + 1 FINAL; Miriam Trinh primary editor. Text is in GERMAN (Latin script), not Yiddish — cf. sheet note "בדייטש". Title page: "Jezias Mizraim (Die Wunder von Egipten) / Biblische Operete in 4 Aufzügen / Von Profesor M. Horowitz, Musik von Perlmutter und Wohl"; Russian parallel title "Ециасъ Мицраимъ ... Соч. Професора М. Горовица. Музыка Перельмутера и Вола". Russian dramatic-censorship stamps: received 5 Sept 1910; 29 Oct 1910 St Petersburg "Къ представленiю признана неудобнымъ" (banned for performance). Library stamps: ЛГТБ No 6246, Рукописный отдел, catalog 1285. Pulled to data/MS_YetsiasMitsrayim 2026-08-18 (67 pp, page/ + page_annotated/ + manifest); not yet annotated. Provenance from the stamps imaged on p.1: purple stamp "РУКОПИСНЫЙ ОТДЕЛ / ЛГТБ № 6246"; red file no. "663 3."; margin no. "1285"; receipt stamp "-5 СЕН. 1910"; and the censor's ban "Къ представленiю признано неудобнымъ. С.-Петербургъ, 29 Окт. 1910". NOT YIVO. Whether our copy is the original or a surrogate still needs confirming.
